## About
Collie Autoworks is a family owned, independent Mercedes-Benz and BMW service center in San Rafael, Marin County. Darren and Denise Collie and our staff will treat your vehicle with the same care and respect you do.
Darren is factory trained and certified to repair Mercedes-Benz. Our staff is Mercedes-Benz Master Certified, ASE Master Certified, and factory and dealership trained. We also service all other German and European motor vehicles, classics included.
Our customers rate us 4.7 from 76 Google reviews. Come by on a weekday to meet our friendly staff, or give us a call with your questions.

## Services
- European Motor Car Mechanical services: Mechanical work on all German and other European vehicles.
- Brake repair and replacement
- Diagnostic and Electrical service: Tracking down warning lights and electrical problems.
- Transmission repair and overhaul
- Air Conditioning service
- Classic German and European vehicles: We also care for classic German and European cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Mercedes-Benz and BMW?
A: No. We also service all other German and European motor vehicles.

Q: When is the shop open?
A: Monday to Friday. Stop by and meet our friendly staff.

Q: Can I come in outside regular hours?
A: Yes, after hours visits are by appointment. Give us a call to set one up.

Q: Where are you?
A: On Irwin Street in San Rafael, near Highway 101.
